mutations.name: E-AUDIT-INITIATOR: initiator_claim must name a run initiator
mutations.old: R.check(actor.get("id") in run.get("initiators", []), "E-AUDIT-INITIATOR", where, "claimed initiator not in run.initiators")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-AUDIT-INITIATOR", where, "claimed initiator not in run.initiators")

mutations.name: E-AUDIT-RUN: audit log must belong to a known run
mutations.old: if not R.check(run is not None, "E-AUDIT-RUN", w, f"run {rid} not found"):
mutations.new: if not R.check(True, "E-AUDIT-RUN", w, f"run {rid} not found"):

mutations.name: E-AUDIT-RUN: audit event run/engagement must match
mutations.old: R.check(ev.get("run_id") == rid and ev.get("engagement_id") == c.engagement.get("engagement_id"), "E-AUDIT-RUN", where, "run/engagement mismatch")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-AUDIT-RUN", where, "run/engagement mismatch")

mutations.name: E-AUDIT-RUN: audit event data_class must match the run
mutations.old: R.check(ev.get("data_class") == run.get("data_class"), "E-AUDIT-RUN", where, "data_class differs from the run")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-AUDIT-RUN", where, "data_class differs from the run")

mutations.name: E-AUDIT-TS: audit timestamps must not go backwards
mutations.old: R.check(t >= prev_t, "E-AUDIT-TS", where, "timestamps must not go backwards")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-AUDIT-TS", where, "timestamps must not go backwards")

mutations.name: E-RUN: run engagement_id must match
mutations.old: R.check(run.get("engagement_id") == e.get("engagement_id"), "E-RUN", w, "engagement_id mismatch")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-RUN", w, "engagement_id mismatch")

mutations.name: E-RUN: run data_class must match
mutations.old: R.check(run.get("data_class") == e.get("data_class"), "E-RUN", w, "data_class differs from the engagement")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-RUN", w, "data_class differs from the engagement")

mutations.name: E-RUN: run calibration_version must match
mutations.old: R.check(run.get("calibration_version") == c.calibration.get("calibration_version"), "E-RUN", w, "calibration_version differs")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-RUN", w, "calibration_version differs")

mutations.name: E-RUN-OWASP: run owasp_llm_version
mutations.old: R.check(run.get("owasp_llm_version") == want_owasp, "E-RUN-OWASP", w, f"owasp_llm_version must be {want_owasp}")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-RUN-OWASP", w, f"owasp_llm_version must be {want_owasp}")

mutations.name: E-RUN-DEADLINE: resume_deadline = opened_at + timeout
mutations.old: R.check(op and dl and lim is not None and dl == op + dt.timedelta(hours=lim), "E-RUN-DEADLINE", w,
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-RUN-DEADLINE", w,

mutations.name: E-RUN-GATES: gate_records in opened_at order
mutations.old: R.check(times == sorted(times), "E-RUN-GATES", w, "gate_records are not in opened_at order")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-RUN-GATES", w, "gate_records are not in opened_at order")

mutations.name: E-RUN-GATES: listed gate record must exist
mutations.old: if R.check(grec is not None, "E-RUN-GATES", w, f"gate record {g['gate_record_id']} not found"):
mutations.new: if R.check(True, "E-RUN-GATES", w, f"gate record {g['gate_record_id']} not found"):

mutations.name: E-RUN-BUDGET: budgets carry the GB new_caps
mutations.old: R.check(all(cur.get(k) == v for k, v in (gb.get("new_caps") or {}).items()), "E-RUN-BUDGET", w,
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-RUN-BUDGET", w,

mutations.name: E-RUN-BUDGET: spent within the cap
mutations.old: R.check(bud.get(spent, 0) <= bud[cap], "E-RUN-BUDGET", w, f"budgets.{ph}.{spent} exceeds {cap}")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-RUN-BUDGET", w, f"budgets.{ph}.{spent} exceeds {cap}")

mutations.name: E-RUN-JOB: job_id equals its key
mutations.old: R.check(job.get("job_id") == jid, "E-RUN-JOB", jw, "job_id != key")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-RUN-JOB", jw, "job_id != key")

mutations.name: E-RUN-JOB: job testcase must exist
mutations.old: if not R.check(tc is not None, "E-RUN-JOB", jw, "testcase not found"):
mutations.new: if not R.check(True, "E-RUN-JOB", jw, "testcase not found"):

mutations.name: E-RUN-JOB: job testcase approved at G4
mutations.old: R.check(job.get("testcase_id") in run.get("approved_testcase_ids", []), "E-RUN-JOB", jw, "job for a testcase not approved at G4")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-RUN-JOB", jw, "job for a testcase not approved at G4")

mutations.name: E-G5-JOB: G5 references an S2 job
mutations.old: R.check(job is not None and job.get("safety_class") == "S2", "E-G5-JOB", w, "G5 must reference an S2 job of the run")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-G5-JOB", w, "G5 must reference an S2 job of the run")

mutations.name: E-GATE-ENGAGEMENT: gate decided inside the engagement validity
mutations.old: R.check(enb and ena and enb <= at <= ena, "E-GATE-ENGAGEMENT", w, "decided outside the engagement validity")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-GATE-ENGAGEMENT", w, "decided outside the engagement validity")

mutations.name: E-GATE-G0-APPROVERS: G0a approvers are the engagement signatories
mutations.old: R.check(want == got, "E-GATE-G0-APPROVERS", w, "G0a approvers must be the engagement signatories")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-GATE-G0-APPROVERS", w, "G0a approvers must be the engagement signatories")

mutations.name: E-GATE-G0-APPROVERS: G0b approvers are the ROE signatories
mutations.old: R.check(want == got, "E-GATE-G0-APPROVERS", w, "G0b approvers must be the ROE signatories")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-GATE-G0-APPROVERS", w, "G0b approvers must be the ROE signatories")

mutations.name: E-GATE-G0-SIG: G0a/G0b carry no signatures
mutations.old: R.check(rec.get("signatures") == [], "E-GATE-G0-SIG", d.path, "G0a/G0b are system verifications: signatures must be []")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-GATE-G0-SIG", d.path, "G0a/G0b are system verifications: signatures must be []")

mutations.name: E-GATE-JOB: job_id only on G5
mutations.old: R.check(rec.get("job_id") is None, "E-GATE-JOB", w, "job_id is only used by G5")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-GATE-JOB", w, "job_id is only used by G5")

mutations.name: E-GATE-ROLES: gate approvers cover the required roles
mutations.old: R.check(GATE_ROLES[gate] <= roles, "E-GATE-ROLES", w, f"missing roles {sorted(GATE_ROLES[gate] - roles)}")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-GATE-ROLES", w, f"missing roles {sorted(GATE_ROLES[gate] - roles)}")

mutations.name: E-GATE-TIME: opened_at not after the decision
mutations.old: R.check(opened <= at, "E-GATE-TIME", w, "opened_at after timestamp")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-GATE-TIME", w, "opened_at after timestamp")

mutations.name: E-GB-APPROVER: GB approver is run_owner or budget_approver
mutations.old: R.check(a.get("person_id") in allowed, "E-GB-APPROVER", w, f"GB approver {a.get('person_id')} is neither run_owner nor budget_approver")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-GB-APPROVER", w, f"GB approver {a.get('person_id')} is neither run_owner nor budget_approver")

mutations.name: E-L1: legal_review required
mutations.old: if not R.check(isinstance(lr, dict), "E-L1", w, "legal_review is required (docs/06 §2.1.1 L-1)"):
mutations.new: if not R.check(True, "E-L1", w, "legal_review is required (docs/06 §2.1.1 L-1)"):

mutations.name: E-L1: legal_review scope items true or justified
mutations.old: R.check(ok, "E-L1", w, f"legal_review.scope.{k} must be true or carry not_applicable_reason")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-L1", w, f"legal_review.scope.{k} must be true or carry not_applicable_reason")

mutations.name: E-L2: attester has an unrevoked key
mutations.old: R.check(bool(live), "E-L2", w, f"legal_review.attested_by {att!r} has no unrevoked registry key")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-L2", w, f"legal_review.attested_by {att!r} has no unrevoked registry key")

mutations.name: E-L2: attester has the legal_reviewer or management role
mutations.old: R.error("E-L2", w, f"{att} has neither the legal_reviewer nor the management role")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-L2", w, f"{att} has neither the legal_reviewer nor the management role")

mutations.name: E-L3: attester signed the ROE
mutations.old: R.check(ok3, "E-L3", w, f"legal_review.attested_by {att} has no valid signature on this ROE")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-L3", w, f"legal_review.attested_by {att} has no valid signature on this ROE")

mutations.name: E-ROE-DATA-CLASS: ROE data_class equals the engagement
mutations.old: R.check(dh.get("data_class") == e.get("data_class"), "E-ROE-DATA-CLASS", w, "data_handling.data_class != engagement data_class")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-ROE-DATA-CLASS", w, "data_handling.data_class != engagement data_class")

mutations.name: E-ROE-ENGAGEMENT: ROE engagement id/version
mutations.old: R.check(eng.get("id") == e.get("engagement_id") and eng.get("version") == e.get("version"), "E-ROE-ENGAGEMENT", w,
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-ROE-ENGAGEMENT", w,

mutations.name: E-ROE-RELAY: ROE relay limits within the toolkit
mutations.old: R.check(trelay.get(k) is not None and relay[k] <= trelay[k], "E-ROE-RELAY", w, f"relay.{k} exceeds toolkit relay")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-ROE-RELAY", w, f"relay.{k} exceeds toolkit relay")

mutations.name: E-ROE-RELAY: ROE relay models allowed for the data class
mutations.old: R.check(mk in (e.get("allowed_models") or {}).get(e.get("data_class"), []), "E-ROE-RELAY", w, f"relay model {mk} not allowed for the data class")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-ROE-RELAY", w, f"relay model {mk} not allowed for the data class")

mutations.name: E-ROE-S3: S3 never allowed
mutations.old: R.check("S3" not in acts.get("allowed_safety_classes", []), "E-ROE-S3", w, "S3 can never be allowed")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-ROE-S3", w, "S3 can never be allowed")

mutations.name: E-ROE-SIGNATORIES: ROE signatories cover the G0b roles
mutations.old: R.check(GATE_ROLES["G0b"] <= roles, "E-ROE-SIGNATORIES", w, f"signatories must include {sorted(GATE_ROLES['G0b'])}")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-ROE-SIGNATORIES", w, f"signatories must include {sorted(GATE_ROLES['G0b'])}")

mutations.name: E-ROE-TOOLS: allowed tools are B4-executable
mutations.old: R.check(spec is not None and any(m.get("b4_executable") for m in (spec.get("modes") or {}).values()), "E-ROE-TOOLS", w,
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-ROE-TOOLS", w,

mutations.name: E-ROE-TOOLS: denied modes are registered
mutations.old: R.check(safety.registry_entry(c.tools, m) is not None, "E-ROE-TOOLS", w, f"denied mode {m!r} is not registered")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-ROE-TOOLS", w, f"denied mode {m!r} is not registered")

mutations.name: E-ROE-VALIDITY: ROE not_before precedes not_after
mutations.old: R.check(nb and na and nb < na, "E-ROE-VALIDITY", w, "not_before must precede not_after")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-ROE-VALIDITY", w, "not_before must precede not_after")

mutations.name: E-ROE-VALIDITY: ROE validity inside the engagement validity
mutations.old: R.check(nb and na and enb and ena and enb <= nb and na <= ena, "E-ROE-VALIDITY", w, "ROE validity must lie inside the engagement validity")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "E-ROE-VALIDITY", w, "ROE validity must lie inside the engagement validity")

mutations.name: W-L2-MANAGEMENT: management attester is flagged
mutations.old: R.warn("W-L2-MANAGEMENT", w, f"{att} attests as management (no legal_reviewer role): flag this in the report")
mutations.new: R.check(True, "W-L2-MANAGEMENT", w, f"{att} attests as management (no legal_reviewer role): flag this in the report")
